speaker: Sheldon
text: I'll tell you what happened. I just learned how to pick up Indian chicks. Maybe you should keep your eye on the ball, Papa.

speaker: Unknown_speaker018
text: I play golf for the father. I won't be able to look at him. Oh, now you're a funny man? This is not funny, Mr. Funny Man.

speaker: Leonard
text: What just happened? Beats the hell out of me. Dr. and Mrs. Kuthapali, in all fairness, it wasn't entirely Raj's fault.

text: This is a family matter, Shandon. Sorry, you all look alike to us.

speaker: Leonard
text: I'm Leonard.

text: But he's right, Papa. Listen to him. You. You are the one who ruined everything.

speaker: Rajesh
text: What are we supposed to say to Nalita's parents? Who is it? We can't see.

speaker: Unknown_speaker018
text: Turn us. Turn us.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Go ahead. Tell my parents why they won't have any grandchildren.

text: How would I know? Do you have a low sperm count?

text: This has nothing to do with my sperm count.

speaker: Rajesh
text: You are wearing the boxers that we sent you, aren't you, Rajesh? Because you know what happens to the samosas when you wear a tidy white case.

text: Yes, mommy.

text: Can we please stop talking about my testicles? Sheldon, tell them what you did.

text: What did I do? I left with his date. Friends don't do that to each other.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Oh. All right, noted.

text: Sorry.

text: Sorry? That's all you can say is sorry?

speaker: Leonard
text: Take it, Raj. It's more than I've ever gotten.

speaker: Sheldon
text: And may I point out, she wouldn't have asked me to go with her if you hadn't been drunk and boring. And boring. Her words.

text: Drunk?

text: I knew it. He moves to America and becomes an alcoholic.

text: I'm not an alcoholic. Just this one time, Papa, I swear.

text: Then why were you drunk?

text: You in denial? Do we have to come over and do an intervention?

speaker: Rajesh
text: Don't embarrass him in front of his friends.

text: Alright. Carry us outside. We want to talk to you in private.

text: Papa, please.

text: Now, Rajesh.

text: I have to go.

text: Now listen to me.

text: It's made it in again to the hall. Okay, well, good night.

text: Hold on. What happened with you and Lalita?

speaker: Sheldon
text: We ate. She lectured me on the link between gum disease and heart attacks, nothing I didn't already know, and I came home.

speaker: Leonard
text: So you're not gonna see her again?

text: Why would I see her again? I already have a dentist.

text: I wonder who's gonna tell his parents they're not having grandchildren.

speaker: Sheldon
text: To life, to life, Lachayom. Lachayom, Lachayom, to life. Life has a way of amusing us, pressing and bruising us. Drink Lachayom to life.

text: I won't believe it. What's gotten into him?
